commands.summary: 768567a (WI 040's closing commit) -- confirms no concurrent work landed since the prior recording pass; not mixing unrelated state into this one.

Ran 138 tests, OK (skipped=2) -- both disclosed, pre-existing, legitimate skips. Confirms the narrow research-metadata test repair following WI 039/WI 040 already landed and main's full suite is currently green, before attributing anything to this pass.
Repository governance validation passed (run before and after this pass's edits).

Located every reference before recording anything: decisions/0016-takeover-repoints-inbound-references.md, repopact/doctor.py, repopact/takeover.py, tests/test_takeover_refs.py, tests/test_validate_repo.py. No JSON schema references the field -- it is free-form frontmatter.

The only existing specification of source_of_truth: resolution. Treats it identically to a Markdown link target, resolved relative to the declaring file, with a leading '../' run preserved verbatim during takeover's repointing rewrite.
Confirms the regex `(?:\.\./)*(?:{retired}...)/...` is written specifically to preserve leading '../' segments -- implements record-relative resolution for exactly this field, matching decision 0016.

Resolves every token with `not (root / token).exists()` -- unconditionally against the repository root, with no record-relative or '../' handling. Inconsistent with takeover.py's treatment of the identical field.

The one existing doctor-side test only exercises a bare, '/'-free token (AGENTS.md) from a record one level below root; it passes under root-relative resolution only because that token coincides with the well-known root-level contract file bootstrap always creates. It does not exercise, and does not establish semantics for, a '../'-prefixed token -- the exact shape both ForgeWire's records and takeover.py's own logic use. Conclusion: record-relative is the documented/implemented intent; doctor.py's root-relative resolution is the outlier -- a definite implementation bug, not a semantic ambiguity and not an invalid ForgeWire record.
